strings.zh: 水都群岛的涨潮季已经过去了,{NEWLINE}这下群岛的公共海域{CLEAR}终于可以自由出入了。{CLEAR}现在如果去那里钓鱼的话,{CLEAR}应该能钓到不少珍惜鱼类吧。
strings.en: High-tide season in the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands is over, so the islands’{CLEAR}public waters are finally open again.{SCROLL}If you go fishing there now, you should{NEWLINE}be able to hook plenty of rare fish.
strings.notes: zh 珍惜 read as a typo for 珍稀 (rare).

strings.zh: 我的精灵都是{NEWLINE}身体柔软的水系精灵,{CLEAR}在面对物理攻击时有点吃力。{CLEAR}我应该收集几只{CLEAR}物理防御特别高的精灵{CLEAR}补充一下队伍。{SCROLL}像是壶壶、大钢蛇、铁甲贝、{NEWLINE}波士可多拉、护城龙、大岩蛇、{CLEAR}朝北巨鼻、核果兽、盔甲鸟、{CLEAR}可多拉、煤炭龟、朝北鼻、{CLEAR}黑夜魔灵、隆隆岩、彷徨夜灵、{CLEAR}古空棘鱼、巨金怪、重甲暴龙、叶精灵{CLEAR}这些物防种族值超过130的精灵,{CLEAR}就非常适合作为我队伍的补充。
strings.en: My Pokémon are all soft-bodied{NEWLINE}Water types, so they struggle{CLEAR}against physical attacks.{SCROLL}I should catch a few Pokémon with really{NEWLINE}high Defense to round out my team.{SCROLL}Shuckle, Steelix, Cloyster, Aggron,{NEWLINE}Bastiodon, Onix, Probopass,{CLEAR}Forretress, Skarmory, Lairon,{CLEAR}Torkoal, Nosepass, Dusknoir,{CLEAR}Golem, Dusclops, Relicanth,{CLEAR}Metagross, Rhyperior, Leafeon...{SCROLL}Pokémon like these, with a base{NEWLINE}Defense over 130, would be{CLEAR}perfect additions to my team.

strings.zh: 自从精灵联盟成立以来,{NEWLINE}大力推进濒危精灵保护工作。{CLEAR}像乘龙这种十年前的濒危物种,{CLEAR}如今已经脱离濒危名单了。
strings.en: Since the Pokémon League was{NEWLINE}founded, it’s been pushing hard{CLEAR}to protect endangered Pokémon.{SCROLL}Lapras, an endangered{NEWLINE}species ten years ago, is{CLEAR}off the endangered list now.

strings.zh: 虽然输掉了对决,{NEWLINE}但是看到精灵从球里出来时{CLEAR}那一瞬间的华丽效果,{CLEAR}我就觉得非常满意。
strings.en: I lost the battle, but seeing that{NEWLINE}flashy effect the moment my Pokémon{CLEAR}came out of its Ball made it all worth it.

strings.zh: 你是训练家吗？{NEWLINE}我刚给球贴上了装饰品。{SCROLL}我想听听你的看法,{NEWLINE}所以能和我来场对决么？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Are you a Trainer?{SCROLL}I just put decorations on my Ball.{NEWLINE}I’d like to hear what you think,{CLEAR}so will you battle me?{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0607/4 | RV042: addition: US line added “right time” and “be amazed”; zh asks for the player’s opinion

strings.zh: 没错,就是要这样！{NEWLINE}我要上了！{SCROLL}
要是带着贴纸的话,{NEWLINE}使用自己的电脑{CLEAR}就可以制作球贴了。{SCROLL}只属于自己的球{NEWLINE}最棒了是不是？{CLEAR}你也试试看吧！{SCROLL}啊！{NEWLINE}做好的球贴{CLEAR}不进行设置是没有办法使用的,{CLEAR}要注意哦！
strings.en: If you’ve got Seals, you can make Ball{NEWLINE}Capsules on your own PC.{SCROLL}A Ball that’s yours alone is the best,{NEWLINE}right? Give it a try!{SCROLL}Oh! A finished Ball Capsule can’t be{NEWLINE}used until you attach it, so be careful!
strings.notes: US 0607/6 | RV042: omission: US line dropped 使用自己的电脑 (on your own PC) and the warning

strings.zh: 啊,是么？{SCROLL}想要看我的球贴的话,{NEWLINE}随时可以跟我说哦！
strings.en: Oh, really?{SCROLL}Talk to me if you want to see my{NEWLINE}Ball Capsule sometime!

strings.zh: 你已经得到钢铁徽章了？{NEWLINE}那么你一定对使用盾牌型的精灵{CLEAR}非常有心得吧。
strings.en: You already have the Mineral Badge?{NEWLINE}Then you must really know your{CLEAR}stuff about shield-type Pokémon.
